|strategy=By Andy Larkin<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001010185041/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/owenlars.html</ref>

Owen and Beru go extremely well together, for a total power of 4, and deploy free at Lars Moisture Farm. What is also neat is Owen's ability of 3. Here's something cool- you can deploy at [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]]: Lars Moisture Farm, Owen, maybe Beru, and a ton of Rebel Troopers, say, 6 or so, all for FREE, and have a huge power number.

You know what's even more incredible? Use [[CZ-3 (Seezee-Three){{!}}CZ-3]] and Don't Overestimate our Chances. That way, you can lure your opponent into a battle, deploy all the Troopers as a react, and use Don't Overestimate our Chances to triple the damage. Great way to get rid of high powered characters.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-owenlars-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Owen Lars]]: The game text changes: “one” becomes “a”; “from table” is added after “Vaporator. If lost”; “the” is removed. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Owen Lars” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
